findings.problem: component deep-copy detached virtualList/virtualGrid nodes from the scroll helper registry. A range request returned true while the published tree retained its old range and children.
findings.fix: A private exact-table ownership predicate preserves registered live virtual nodes during copying. Ordinary authored data remains copied, and the live-node ownership exception is documented.
findings.command: PowerShell read scroll.luau and components.luau into memory, escaped them into loadstring calls, and piped a component-wrapped virtualList reproduction into .toolcache/luau-0.734/luau.exe. The fixed reproduction supplied helpers.isManagedNode as the package factory's third argument. No temporary source files were created.
findings.regression_review: Reviewed the EngineRuntime list/grid regression source, including unchanged frame/observations and first-tick RNG/counter comparison. Root reported its integration tests passed; this reviewer did not run Cargo.

findings.problem: Android packaging queried an existing Windows capability executable. After a package version change, its stale version could be copied into runtime.json despite the new Android binary embedding the current version.
findings.fix: Assert-CurrentNativeRuntimePackages compares the descriptor's complete package map against the current canonical manifest, using ordinal package IDs and exact string versions, before output directory creation or copying.
